description.zh: 签约前审合同：按主体、价款支付、交付验收、违约责任、知识产权、保密、争议解决等清单逐项识别风险，给出风险等级和可直接替换的修改条款，并把意见批注到合同 Word 副本上、输出风险清单；也能对比两版合同。审阅意见仅供参考，不构成法律意见。
description.en: Reviews contracts before signing: checklist-based risk review (parties, payment, acceptance, liability, IP, confidentiality, disputes) with risk levels and drop-in clause fixes, comments written onto a Word copy, a risk list, and version comparison. For reference only — not legal advice.

welcome_message.zh: 把合同 Word 发给我，告诉我你是甲方还是乙方
welcome_message.en: Send me the contract and tell me which side you're on

description.zh: 风险清单 + 修改条款

prompt.zh: 我上传了合同 ___，我方是 ___（甲方/乙方），帮我审一下风险并给出修改建议。
prompt.en: I uploaded contract ___. We are the ___ party. Review the risks and suggest changes.

description.zh: 意见批注在 Word 上

prompt.zh: 把审阅意见批注到合同 ___ 的副本上，并输出风险清单 Excel。
prompt.en: Add the review comments to a copy of ___ and export a risk list.

prompt.zh: 只看这份合同的付款、验收和违约责任条款，我方是 ___，有什么风险？
prompt.en: Only check payment, acceptance, and liability clauses. We are the ___ party.

prompt.zh: 对方返回了修改稿 ___，和我们的原稿 ___ 对比一下，哪些改动对我方不利？
prompt.en: The other side returned ___. Compare it with our draft ___ — which changes hurt us?

description.zh: 保密、知识产权、责任上限

prompt.zh: 帮我起草一条 ___ 条款，我方是 ___，交易背景：___。
prompt.en: Draft a ___ clause. We are the ___ party. Context: ___.

prompt.zh: 对方要求修改 ___ 条款为 ___，帮我写一段专业的回复，提出折中方案。
prompt.en: The other side wants clause ___ changed to ___. Draft a professional reply with a compromise.

zh: 每个工作日「09:00」检查 inbound 目录新上传的合同，生成审阅意见初稿
每周五「16:00」汇总本周审阅的合同和高风险条款，生成清单
每月 1 日「10:00」列出未来 60 天内到期或需续签的合同
每次收到对方修改稿后「30 分钟内」对比两版合同并列出不利改动
每季度第一个工作日「10:00」根据本季度审阅情况更新常用修改条款库
每周一「09:30」提醒我跟进上周审阅后仍在谈判中的合同
en: Every weekday at 09:00, draft review notes for new contracts in inbound
Every Friday at 16:00, summarize this week's reviewed contracts and high-risk clauses
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, list contracts expiring or due for renewal in 60 days
Within 30 minutes of receiving a counter-draft, compare versions and list unfavorable changes
On the first weekday of each quarter at 10:00, update the clause library from recent reviews
Every Monday at 09:30, remind me to follow up on contracts still in negotiation
